name: BTG Mumbai Bureau
bio: The Bombay Times Group Mumbai Bureau covers civic affairs, transport, housing, crime, courts and the environment across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and Thane.

name: BTG National Desk
bio: The National Desk tracks politics, the courts, governance and major developments across India's states.

name: BTG Business Desk
bio: The Business Desk covers markets, company earnings, banking and insurance, commodities and personal finance, with a focus on Mumbai as India's financial capital.

name: BTG Sports Desk
bio: The Sports Desk covers cricket, hockey, football, tennis and Indian athletes in domestic and international competition.

name: BTG World Desk
bio: The World Desk reports on international affairs, diplomacy and elections, and what they mean for India.

name: BTG Entertainment Desk
bio: The Entertainment Desk covers Hindi cinema, box office, streaming, music and the people who make Mumbai's film industry.

name: BTG Education Desk
bio: The Education Desk covers entrance exams, results, admissions and policy for students and parents.
